v1.0.0: the family is now AI KEY

Commands go from /zmm-… to /aikey-…, display names carry the AI KEY
brand, and the byline is the account name 澳洲AI教父. Judgements, flows
and rules are untouched — this release contains names and nothing else,
so if a channel breaks, the cause is unambiguous.

Old links keep working: the repo rename redirects, and the bundle ships
under both aikey-toolbox.zip and the old zmm-toolbox.zip.
